# Feature Specification: Shared Photo Albums

**Feature Branch**: `001-photo-albums`
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Status**: Draft
**Input**: User description: "Let families create shared photo albums, invite relatives by link, and get a weekly digest of new photos."

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

### User Story 1 - Create an album and upload photos (Priority: P1)

A user creates an album, gives it a name and uploads photos from their phone or desktop.

**Why this priority**: Without albums and uploads there is no product.

**Independent Test**: Create an album, upload 10 photos, see them in a grid sorted by date taken.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a signed-in user, **When** they create an album named "Summer 2026", **Then** it appears in their album list.
2. **Given** an album, **When** the user uploads 10 JPEG photos, **Then** all 10 appear sorted by EXIF date.

---

### User Story 2 - Invite relatives by link (Priority: P1)

The album owner shares an invite link. Anyone with the link can view and add photos.

**Why this priority**: Sharing is the core value proposition.

**Independent Test**: Open the invite link in a private window, join, upload a photo.

---

### User Story 3 - Weekly digest email (Priority: P2)

Members receive a weekly email with thumbnails of new photos in albums they belong to.

**Why this priority**: Drives re-engagement but the product works without it.

---

### Edge Cases

- What happens when an invite link is leaked publicly? [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: should links expire or be revocable?]
- How are duplicate uploads of the same photo handled?
- What happens to photos when a member leaves the album? [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: do their photos stay or get removed?]

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Functional Requirements

- **FR-001**: System MUST allow signed-in users to create albums with a name of up to 80 characters.
- **FR-002**: System MUST accept JPEG, PNG and HEIC uploads up to 25 MB each.
- **FR-003**: System MUST generate a unique invite link per album.
- **FR-004**: Anyone with an invite link MUST be able to view and upload photos to that album.
- **FR-005**: System MUST send a weekly digest email every Monday at 08:00 in the member's timezone.
- **FR-006**: System MUST strip GPS location from EXIF metadata before photos are visible to other members.
- **FR-007**: System MUST retain original files for [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: retention period not specified].

### Key Entities

- **Album**: name, owner, invite token, created at.
- **Photo**: file, album, uploader, taken at, uploaded at.
- **Membership**: user, album, role (owner, member), joined at.

## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*

- **SC-001**: 80% of new albums receive at least one invited member within 7 days.
- **SC-002**: Upload of 10 photos completes in under 30 seconds on a 20 Mbps connection.

# Implementation Plan: Shared Photo Albums

**Branch**: `001-photo-albums` | **Date**: 2026-11-21 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

## Summary

Web app with a REST API. Photos go straight from the browser to object storage with presigned URLs;
a background worker builds thumbnails, strips GPS data and sends the weekly digest.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Python 3.12 (API, worker), TypeScript 5 (web)
**Primary Dependencies**: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, React 19
**Storage**: PostgreSQL 16 for metadata, S3-compatible object storage for files
**Testing**: pytest, Playwright
**Target Platform**: Linux containers on Kubernetes
**Project Type**: web
**Performance Goals**: 10 photo uploads in under 30 s on 20 Mbps
**Constraints**: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: monthly storage budget per family]
**Scale/Scope**: 5k families in the first year

## Constitution Check

- Library-first: thumbnail and EXIF handling live in `photos_core`, independent from the API. PASS
- Test-first: contract tests before endpoints. PASS

## Project Structure

```text
backend/
  src/api/  src/worker/  src/photos_core/
  tests/contract/  tests/integration/
frontend/
  src/pages/  src/components/
```
documents.research.md:
# Research: Shared Photo Albums

## Upload path

- **Decision**: Browser uploads directly to object storage with presigned URLs.
- **Rationale**: Keeps 25 MB files off the API servers and meets the 30 s upload goal.
- **Alternatives considered**: Upload through the API; tus resumable uploads

## Invite model

- **Decision**: One permanent invite token per album, anyone with the link gets member rights.
- **Rationale**: Lowest friction for non-technical relatives.
- **Alternatives considered**: Per-person email invites; expiring links; view-only links plus upload approval

## HEIC support

- **Decision**: Convert HEIC to JPEG in the worker and keep the original.
- **Rationale**: Most browsers cannot render HEIC.
- **Alternatives considered**: Reject HEIC; convert in the browser

## Digest delivery

- **Decision**: Celery beat job every hour that sends digests to members whose local time is Monday 08:00.
- **Rationale**: Respects timezones without one job per user.
- **Alternatives considered**: One scheduled job per user; send everyone at 08:00 UTC

# Tasks: Shared Photo Albums

## Phase 1: Setup

- [x] T001 Create backend and frontend project structure per plan.md
- [x] T002 [P] Configure ruff, mypy and eslint
- [ ] T003 [P] Provision PostgreSQL and object storage in docker-compose

## Phase 2: Foundational

- [ ] T004 Create Album, Photo and Membership models in backend/src/api/models.py
- [ ] T005 [P] Implement EXIF reader and GPS stripping in backend/src/photos_core/exif.py
- [ ] T006 [P] Implement thumbnail generation in backend/src/photos_core/thumbs.py

## Phase 3: User Story 1 - Create an album and upload photos (P1)

- [ ] T007 [US1] Contract test POST /albums in backend/tests/contract/test_albums.py
- [ ] T008 [US1] Implement POST /albums and GET /albums
- [ ] T009 [P] [US1] Implement presigned upload URL endpoint
- [ ] T010 [US1] Worker job: thumbnail, HEIC conversion, GPS stripping on upload
- [ ] T011 [P] [US1] Album grid page sorted by date taken in frontend/src/pages/Album.tsx

## Phase 4: User Story 2 - Invite relatives by link (P1)

- [ ] T012 [US2] Generate invite token on album creation
- [ ] T013 [US2] Join album via invite link endpoint
- [ ] T014 [P] [US2] Join page in frontend/src/pages/Join.tsx

## Phase 5: User Story 3 - Weekly digest email (P2)

- [ ] T015 [US3] Hourly Celery beat job selecting members at Monday 08:00 local time
- [ ] T016 [P] [US3] Digest email template with thumbnails

## Phase 6: Polish

- [ ] T017 [P] Playwright end-to-end test for create, invite, upload
- [ ] T018 Load test 10 parallel uploads on a throttled 20 Mbps connection
